description: This file contains JUnit test cases for the PatientProgram class in the OpenMRS core project, specifically testing methods like voidLastState, transitionToState, and getSortedStates.

classes.name: PatientProgramTest
classes.description: JUnit test class for testing the behavior of the PatientProgram class methods.

methods.name: voidLastState_shouldVoidStateWithEndDateNullIfStartDatesEqual
methods.description: Tests that the voidLastState method correctly voids a state with a null end date when start dates are equal.

methods.name: voidLastState_shouldVoidStateWithEndDateEqualToProgramCompletionDate
methods.description: Tests that the voidLastState method correctly voids a state whose end date equals the program's completion date.

methods.name: transitionToDate_shouldSetEndDateOfNewStateToProgramCompletionDateIfProgramCompleted
methods.description: Verifies that transitionToState sets the end date of the new state to the program's completion date if the program is marked as completed.

methods.name: transitionToDate_shouldSetEndDateOfNewStateToNullIfProgramNotCompleted
methods.description: Verifies that transitionToState sets the end date of the new state to null if the program is not yet completed.

methods.name: getSortedStates_shouldReturnAllStatesEvenIfTwoHaveIdenticalStartAndEndDates
methods.description: Ensures that getSortedStates returns all states, including multiple states with identical start and end dates, correctly sorted.
